=== List the available index types

[source,cypher]
----
CALL spatial.indexTypes.list()
----

.Result

[opts="header",cols="2"]
|===
|id|description
|geohash|A point index using Geohash-style bit-interleaving of latitude and longitude. Provides efficient prefix-based range searches for geographic coordinates.
|hilbert|A spatial point index using a Hilbert Space-Filling Curve to map 2D coordinates to a 1D sequence for efficient range and proximity searches.
|rtree|In-graph R-Tree index for spatial data, providing balanced tree structures for efficient geometric range and containment queries.
|zorder|A spatial point index using a Z-Order (Morton) space-filling curve to map 2D coordinates to 1D values for efficient range searches.
|===
